description: This file defines the EmployeeCountAPI class, a PHP API endpoint within the OrangeHRM system for retrieving the count of employees possibly filtered by various criteria. It handles HTTP GET requests to '/api/v2/pim/employees/count' and utilizes traits and validators for processing request parameters and returning the count data in a structured format.
